figures.Fig14.9: Graphical representation of displacement, velocity and acceleration of S.H.M. Original figure archived as c12-phy-ch14-fig-xva (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book says the phase difference between acceleration and displacement is pi/2; it is pi. Its velocity and acceleration graphs do not match x = xo cos(wt). Corrected in a warning and in the redrawn graphs.
